mods.name: Spotify Radio
mods.description: Plays Spotify Connect or the player's own music on an in-game radio station. Audio heard only by the player; nothing other players see, hear or race against.

mods.name: Extra Options - Garage Revving
mods.description: Garage engine revving (garage-engine-rev): hold RT in the garage to hear the engine. Garage only; nothing other players see, hear or race against.
